-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.Protocol.ReadIndex` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

theorem doomed_intro [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (T t n : w64) (G : List EntryM) (a : w64) (c :
    CfgM) (q : GSet w64) : uint.Z T < uint.Z t → 0 < uint.Z n → ⊢ cqAt γ t n G a c q -∗ ∃ U, doomed
    γ T t U

theorem rqRecOk_confirm [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (T : w64) (r : RqRec) (P : List EntryM) (c :
    CfgM) (Q : GSet w64) (Hst : γ.reDyn = none) : CfgAt γ P c → JQuorum c Q → (∀ (v : w64), v ∈ Q →
    ∀ (t' : w64) (q : GSet w64), r.snd = some (t', q) → ¬v ∈ q) → ⊢ rqRecOk γ T r -∗ readOk γ
    r.fst.fst r.fst.snd

theorem read_collect [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (E : CoPset) (c : List w8) (Qr : List
    EntryM → IProp GF) (i : w64) (L : List EntryM) : ↑(raftN γ) ⊆ E → uint.Z i ≤ ↑L.length → ⊢
    raftCommitInv γ -∗ readWit γ c Qr i -∗ isCommitted γ L ={E}=∗ ▷ ▷ □ Qr L

theorem ownLogGhost_within [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState) (kl :
    Option w64) (G : List EntryM) : s.role = Role.leader → ⊢ isLeader γ id s.term -∗ leadFull γ
    s.term G -∗ ownLogGhost γ id s kl -∗ ⌜plogLastIndexZ base0 G ≤ plogLastIndexZ s.base s.log⌝

theorem ownRaftGhost_read_arrive [ReceiptGS GF] {md : Bool} [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s
    : PState) (c : List w8) (Lc : List EntryM) : s.role = Role.leader → plogTermAt s.base s.log
    s.commit = some s.term → ⊢ ownRaftGhost γ id s md -∗ readReq γ c Lc ={⊤ \ ↑(raftRegN γ)}=∗
    ownRaftGhost γ id s md ∗ ∃ d, rqRecOk γ s.term ((c, s.commit), d)

theorem readReq_agree [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (c : List w8) (L1 L2 : List EntryM) : ⊢ readReq
    γ c L1 -∗ readReq γ c L2 -∗ ⌜L1 = L2⌝

theorem ownLogGhost_commitIn [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState) (kl :
    Option w64) : ⊢ ownLogGhost γ id s kl -∗ ∃ fp, ⌜FullOk s.base fp ∧ LogOk s⌝ ∗ logRecs γ base0 fp
    ∗ logRecs γ s.base s.log ∗ commitIn γ (fp ++ s.log) s.commit s.term

theorem node_leader [ReceiptGS GF] {md : Bool} [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id2 : w64) (ps2 : PState)
    : ps2.role = Role.leader → ⊢ ownRaftGhost γ id2 ps2 md -∗ ∃ fp2 F0, ⌜FullOk ps2.base fp2 ∧
    PlogWf ps2.base ps2.log ∧ F0 <+: fp2 ++ ps2.log⌝ ∗ logRecs γ base0 fp2 ∗ logRecs γ ps2.base
    ps2.log ∗ isLeader γ id2 ps2.term ∗ isCamp γ id2 ps2.term F0 ∗ leadFull γ ps2.term (fp2 ++
    ps2.log)

theorem rqRecOk_confirm_dyn [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (T L : w64) (r : RqRec) (FL
    F0L : List EntryM) (aL cL : w64) (c : CfgM) (Q : GSet w64) (Hdyn : γ.reDyn ≠ none) (Y : IProp
    GF) (HLw : ∀ (G : List EntryM), ⊢ Y -∗ leadFull γ T G -∗ ⌜plogLastIndexZ base0 G ≤
    plogLastIndexZ base0 FL⌝) : CfgAt γ (List.take (uint.Z aL).toNat FL) c → JQuorum c Q → confCount
    (List.drop (uint.Z aL).toNat FL) ≤ 1 → uint.Z aL ≤ uint.Z cL → PlogWf base0 FL → CampOk T F0L →
    F0L <+: FL → (∀ (v : w64), v ∈ Q → ∀ (t' : w64) (q : GSet w64), r.snd = some (t', q) → ¬v ∈ q) →
    ⊢ votesTbl γ -∗ isLeader γ L T -∗ isCamp γ L T F0L -∗ logRecs γ base0 FL -∗ isCommitted γ
    (List.take (uint.Z aL).toNat FL) -∗ commitIn γ FL cL T -∗ leadFull γ T FL -∗ Y -∗ rqRecOk γ T r
    -∗ readOk γ r.fst.fst r.fst.snd

theorem leaderWit_leader [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState) (h :
    s.role = Role.leader) : leaderWit γ id s = isLeader γ id s.term

theorem doom_choice [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (G : List EntryM) (T tD : w64) (m : Nat) : ⊢ (∀ k
    x x, ∃ tw nw Gw aw cw qw x, cqAt γ tw nw Gw aw cw qw) -∗ ∃ U, (∀ u x, ∃ t'' i'', ⌜uint.Z T <
    uint.Z t'' ∧ 0 < uint.Z i''⌝ ∗ isAcked γ u t'' i'') ∗ ∀ k x x, ∃ tw nw Gw aw cw qw, ⌜WitOk G k
    tw nw Gw aw (uint.Z tD + 1) ∧ (uint.Z T < uint.Z tw → ∀ (x : w64), x ∈ qw → x ∈ U)⌝ ∗ cqAt γ tw
    nw Gw aw cw qw

theorem ownRaftGhost_term_nz [ReceiptGS GF] {md : Bool} [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s :
    PState) : s.role ≠ Role.follower → ⊢ ownRaftGhost γ id s md -∗ ⌜s.term ≠ W64 0⌝

theorem readAu_fire_open [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (Qr : List EntryM → IProp GF) (l
    : List EntryM) : ⊢ readAu γ Qr -∗ ghostVar γ.reRLog (Qp.half 1) l ={(⊤ \ ↑(raftRegN γ)) \
    ↑(raftLogN γ)}=∗ ghostVar γ.reRLog (Qp.half 1) l ∗ □ Qr l

theorem CampOk.term_nz {T : w64} {F : List EntryM} (H : CampOk T F) : T ≠ W64 0

theorem ownLogGhost_prefix_within [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState)
    (kl : Option w64) (ldr : w64) (bL : entryID) (l : List EntryM) : s.role = Role.leader → ⊢
    isLeader γ id s.term -∗ leadPrefix γ ldr s.term bL l -∗ ownLogGhost γ id s kl -∗ ⌜min
    (plogLastIndexZ bL l) (2 ^ 64 - 1) ≤ plogLastIndexZ s.base s.log⌝ ∗ ownLogGhost γ id s kl

theorem read_arrive_core [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState) (c : List
    w8) (Lc P fp : List EntryM) : s.role = Role.leader → s.term ≠ W64 0 → plogTermAt s.base s.log
    s.commit = some s.term → Lc <+: P → FullOk s.base fp → LogOk s → ↑γ.reBoot.length ≤ uint.Z
    s.commit → ⊢ committedJust γ P -∗ votesTbl γ -∗ lcmOwn γ id s -∗ isLeader γ id s.term -∗
    commitIn γ (fp ++ s.log) s.commit s.term -∗ readReq γ c Lc -∗ votesTbl γ ∗ lcmOwn γ id s ∗ ∃ d,
    rqRecOk γ s.term ((c, s.commit), d)

theorem read_deposit [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (c : List w8) (Qr : List EntryM →
    IProp GF) (L0 : List EntryM) : ⊢ raftCommitInv γ -∗ rdFresh γ c -∗ readAu γ Qr -∗ isCommitted γ
    L0 ={⊤}=∗ ∃ Lc, ⌜L0 <+: Lc⌝ ∗ readReq γ c Lc ∗ isRead γ c Qr

theorem readOk_prefix [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (c : List w8) (i : w64) (Lc D : List EntryM) :
    uint.Z i ≤ ↑D.length → ⊢ readOk γ c i -∗ readReq γ c Lc -∗ isCommitted γ D -∗ ⌜Lc <+: D⌝
